name: MySQL/MariaDB Database Server
description: Backup of MySQL/MariaDB databases, binary logs, and configuration
recommended_schedule: Hourly Binary Log, Daily Incremental, Weekly Full
notes: Use mysqldump or MySQL Enterprise Backup for online backups
Binary logs required for point-in-time recovery
Backup my.cnf and mysql user/privilege tables
Consider Bareos MySQL plugin for consistent online backups
Monitor binary log size and purging
Document MySQL/MariaDB version and storage engine (InnoDB/MyISAM)
For replication, backup from slave with --dump-slave option

post_backup_script.description: Flush and purge old binary logs
post_backup_script.linux: mysql -e 'FLUSH LOGS; PURGE BINARY LOGS BEFORE DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);'
